summary.text: Jack Howard is the Republican candidate for the Missouri House of Representatives, District 74, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where Democratic incumbent Marla Smith is also on the ballot.

paragraphs.text: Jack Howard was the unopposed Republican nominee after the August 4, 2026 primary.
He was also the Republican candidate for District 74 in 2024, when Marla Smith defeated him in the general election.
